name: Bar Editor
author: David JM
description: Terminal editor for the Omarchy bar: layout widgets across the left/center/right sections, bar position and transparency, idle timeouts, and [bar] styling in shell.toml.

barWidget.description: One bar icon that opens a mouse-aware terminal editor for the bar layout, settings, styling, and idle timeouts. Changes are saved to ~/.config/omarchy/shell.json and shell.toml and hot-reloaded by the shell.
